analysis: The PR changes only documentation: docs/developer/build.md (new SDK 27.2 Date comparison section at head lines 181-192) and docs/developer/test.md (new Date check commands, patch hunk at +1059..1072). No source, workflow, or threat-model code is in the supplied units, so no authorization, attestation, encryption, or data-exposure behavior changes. The docs describe two new checks, scripts/check-date-comparisons.py (source-level) and scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py (binary-level via nm/otool), which guard against a crash from weak-imported Foundation Date operators. They are a defensive availability and reliability control touching the release pipeline (relevant to TB-011/A-017 only indirectly through release qualification). The docs state the source check has no types and may miss comparisons, and that the binary check is the backstop. The scripts, workflow wiring (ci.yml Release Integrity, the provider-release-build action) and the test files are not in the supplied units, so I could not verify that they exist or enforce what the docs claim. This is an unverified contract, not a finding. The remaining build.md text, e.g. the CI cache and runner routing sections and the TB-011 App Attest qualification text, is unchanged context and I did not treat it as new. I identified no concrete security regressions. The next pass should confirm that the referenced scripts and workflow steps are added and fail closed, if they are in the PR's other batches.
